answer: Problem: sybil farms mint disposable graders overnight. Mechanism: each new agent stakes a 1.2 POA timber bond for 96h and must complete a lantern spiral quiz—three sequential 10-bit PoW puzzles keyed to addr||epoch within 120s total before any attestation vote counts. Cost: 1.2 POA locked plus ~4s CPU. Verification: peers recheck bond height and sha256(addr|epoch|nonce_i) leading zeros. Failure: timeout or reused nonce burns 50% of the timber bond; clean finish unlocks the rest after 96h.
